_comment: Hand-verified expected output for fixtures/msm-gig-guide-sample.txt (Sprint 5A, item 6). This is NOT a full 226-row snapshot of whatever the implementation happens to produce -- it's a curated set of representative and edge-case rows, each checked by hand against the raw fixture text, so a future regression in the parser or profile trips a real assertion instead of being silently re-baselined. Row indices are stable because msm-gig-guide-sample.txt's 'View Details' markers are processed in file order.
